findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be available at meat department. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer solution was prepared and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure each department has an sanitizer solution available during lol hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed black mold to be present at the back triple sink. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure caulking is being replaced at a frequency that prevents black mold build up.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed multiple TCS items to be held past there date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, items were pulled and discarded. Ensure TCS item is discarded after its 7 day date marking maximum.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: Observed single service containers to be stored in a shelving unit with significant rust showing. Discussed with PIC, single service containers were discarded and new container were placed in a contamination free location. Ensure single service containers are being stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed black mold to be present at the back triple sink. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure caulking is being replaced at a frequency that prevents black mold build up.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed multiple boxes of food to be in contact with an icicle forming under fan unit in walk in freezer. Discussed with PIC, items within boxes are sealed. Upon inspection, TCS items within boxes were untouched by ice. PIC relocated boxes and walk in freezer will be serviced. Ensure any food item being stored is protected from any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Observed walk in freezer to have excessive amounts of ice accumulation forming under fan unit. Discussed with PIC, walk in freezer will be serviced. Ensure equipment is maintained and working up to manufacter’s standards.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed a wall cooler to be cold holding foods between 45F-59F. Discussed with PIC, TCS foods were probed, pulled, and discarded. TCS foods placed this morning were pulled and relocated in walk in cooler/freezer to drop temperatures. Ensure any TCS food being cold held is kept at or below 41F.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment: Observed a wall cooler to be holding incorrect temperatures. At the time of inspection, the cooler had just finishing a defrost cycle and items were above 41F. After a few minutes temperatures began to drop, however the whole unit was not holding the same temperature. The corners of the cooler and areas packed too tightly continued to hold temperatures ranging from 47F-53F. Discussed with PIC, this cooler has had issues in the past maintaining proper cold holding temperatures. A follow-up has been issued for 5/1/2025.
findings.citation_text: 4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
(Repeat x2) Observed the following areas in need of physical facility repairs:
1. Caulk the holes in the wall in the following places: above the triple sink, and next to the breading station. 
2. Caulking at the tripe sink is in a state of disrepair and black mold is present. 

Discussed with PIC, the following issues will be corrected. Ensure staff is monitoring physical facility.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed an employee to not wash hands after soiling gloves by touching dirty, non-food surfaces. Discussed with PIC, ensure staff wearing gloves are changing gloves and washing hands at a frequency that prevents contamination. 

2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed an employee washing broccoli in the hand sink. Discussed with PIC, practice was stopped and education was provided. Ensure hand washing sink is only being used for hand washing. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed a whole wall cooler to be cold holding foods between 45F-55F. Thermometers within cooler read 41F-42F, and continued to rise during inspection. Discussed with PIC, TCS food were probed then pulled to be discarded. Majority of foods kept included hard cheeses, and non-TCS foods. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
Observed a wall cooler to be holding incorrect temperature. The thermometer within the unit read 41F-42F, however the food kept within read a temperature of 45F-55F. Discussed with PIC, this cooler is given extra coolant once a week to ensure temperature is being held correctly, however this is the 4th time this cooler has gone down requiring food to be thrown away in the last 6 months according to PIC. Ensure any cold holding equipment is able to accurately cold hold foods at 41F or lower. 

4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following non food contact surface areas to be in need of cleaning:
1)The lids of the seasoning containers in the kitchen were soiled with seasoning accumulation. 
2) The hot holding station had an accumulation of food debris along the outside edge.
3) Under the rotisserie oven, an accumulation of grease was visible behind catch buckets. 

Discussed with PIC, the seasoning lids were cleaned and corrected on site. Ensure non food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency that prevents and food accumulation. 

4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

(REPEAT X2) Observed the following areas in need of physical facility repairs:
1. Caulk the holes in the wall in the following places: above the 3 compartment sink, next to the breading station (above prep table).
2. Caulking at the triple sink has been removed from wear/tear and the remaining caulking is moldy. Re-caulk the 3 compartment sink.
